title: Etale-origin witnesses in two scalar presentations
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme in universe u, k a field in universe u+1, and T any cochain complex of fixed-k pro-etale module sheaves. Let M be its fixedScalarDerivedModel [def-sfb-fixed-scalar-complex-model]. Then M has an etale antecedent C on the coefficient-sized constant-ring site, bounded constructible [def-pe-etale-constructible-module] with finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude] and a cochain representative whose comparison pullback is isomorphic to M, if and only if there is a bounded constructible fixed-k etale complex D on the original site with Q(T) isomorphic to Q of its comparison pullback and one ordered interval outside which D tensor N has zero homology for every degree-zero fixed-k etale sheaf N. The right-hand predicates and termwise tensor are exactly those in [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data], with no integral ring or completeness datum.

source.place: lemma-compare-constructible-derived (Tag 09AL), in the two equivalent presentations; sites-modules.tex Tag 03CY; Bhatt--Scholze Remark 6.3.2

proof.text: Use the explicit exact cochain and derived scalar equivalences. The ordinary comparison square lifts termwise and then localizes, identifying origin isomorphisms in both presentations.

Transport homology along the exact scalar equivalence and the localization factors. Use the constructibility bridge for each cohomology sheaf; preserve and reflect zero objects to keep the same cohomological interval.

In the forward direction apply fixed-field tensor bounds on the original site. In the reverse direction use the coefficient-field bounded-flat criterion. Compose the comparison isomorphisms; full faithfulness of the pro-etale derived equivalence recovers the original origin isomorphism.

theorem fixedScalar_etaleOrigin (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (k : Type (u + 1)) [Field k]
    (T : CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)) ℤ) :
    (∃ C : ConstantCompletion.D (ConstantCompletion.constant
        (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, u} X) k),
      IsCoefficientBoundedConstructibleEtale.{u, u} X k C ∧
        (∃ a b : ℤ, HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude _ C a b) ∧
        ∃ P : ConstantCompletion.Cx (ConstantCompletion.constant
            (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, u} X) k),
          Nonempty ((ConstantCompletion.Q _).obj P ≅ C) ∧
            Nonempty ((ConstantCompletion.Q _).obj
              ((ProEtale.constructibleComparisonComplexPullback.{u, u} X k).obj P) ≅
                fixedScalarDerivedModel X k T)) ↔
      ∃ C : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)) ℤ,
        (∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) → IsZero (C.homology q)) ∧
        (∀ q : ℤ, IsConstructibleSheaf (C.homology q)) ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k) X).mapHomologicalComplex
             (.up ℤ)).obj C)) ∧
        ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧
          ∀ (N : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)) (q : ℤ),
            (q < a ∨ b < q) →
              IsZero ((sfbEtaleTensorDegreeZero X k C N).homology q)
